items.caption: A modern redraw labeled as 期 in Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen analyzes 期 as 會, “meeting,” and describes it as 月 with 其 as the sound element; this image illustrates that dictionary tradition, not a securely dated stage in the character’s history.
items.alt: Black composite glyph on a white background, with a compact angular shape at the upper left, two tall strokes descending on the right, and a long lower stroke extending into a curved hook.
items.selection_reason: The image is labeled as a modern seal-script-style redraw of 期, making it useful for illustrating the form associated with the Shuowen account. Its visible components are not independently established by the cited evidence, and the redraw does not date the form.

limitations.text: The image’s label and modern redraw provenance do not resolve the dating or sequence of 日-bearing and 月-bearing forms. Reports describe both types in bronze materials, while Shuowen calls 𣅆, written with 日 and 丌, an ancient form; these accounts do not establish one complete chronology.
